area: prism occlusion, the Urchin and Manta hulls, the colour sweep, the cell conveyor
summary: Five bug-ledger fixes in your systems, no kit number or look changed: the occlusion corridor measures a hull again when it was hidden at bind time (ba3ad0569a), VesselAnimation exposes IsInitialized and the Urchin's pods wait on it (d8a7763cd0, your ticket #1773), a Manta decoy is built from Update in the same frame because Unity refuses its strip inside OnTriggerEnter (dedc985d2a), UIThemeLive.SwapSea reads a TMP sub-mesh's sharedMaterial (c0ef0c8281), and CellConveyor.OnDestroy skips the strike when the scene itself is closing (d391dc761d).
why: Console errors the editors sent to the Bug Ledger: E-5f2ee86d9b, E-d6b3d6f496, E-75a12f0559, E-3e99fba873, E-0f0eb8a59f, E-c703a8f80b.
